title: What Does a Virtual Assistant Do? A Complete Guide to Virtual Assistant Tasks
summary: What does a virtual assistant do? Explore common virtual assistant tasks, real-world examples, and the top tasks you can outsource to save time and grow your business.
body_markdown:
14 min read


You’re sitting at your desk, staring at a calendar that looks like a losing game of Tetris and an inbox that just will not stop growing. The administrative overload is real, and it’s burning you out. The issue isn’t whether you need help, but choosing the type of support that actually improves how your business operates.


A virtual assistant is a remote worker who provides support to a business. They can handle a diverse set of tasks, ranging from routine admin work and social media management to graphic design. Virtual assistants usually operate independently and communicate with their clients through digital channels. This flexible arrangement enables businesses to find the right expertise regardless of geographical location.


## The Hidden Cost of Doing It All Yourself


Managing everything internally drains your most valuable resource: your time. When you handle every minor administrative detail, you become the primary bottleneck in your own business. It is a massive opportunity cost.


Consider the sheer volume of productive hours lost to routine maintenance. Managing documents takes up


[one to three hours in a person’s workday](https://www.paperwise.com/how-to-improve-employee-productivity-with-document-management/) for about three in every four people. That’s time you could be spending on high-level strategy or revenue-generating work.


Small businesses recognize this operational drain. In the U.S. alone,


[90% of small businesses](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/almost-all-small-businesses-outsource-work-in-2022-new-research-finds-301527790.html) plan to outsource a business process due to its perceived benefits. Delegating time-consuming tasks to a virtual assistant frees up valuable time so you can focus on strategic initiatives. With the right support, you don’t have to do everything by yourself.


## What Do Virtual Assistants Do?


So,


*what can a virtual assistant do exactly?*


A virtual assistant can provide support to your business operations by taking on tasks that eat up your time. Their duties span a wide range of activities, from internal admin work to cold outreach calls. The overall focus of general virtual assistance is on routine, non-specialized tasks. This includes clerical and admin work, as well as basic functions in data management and digital marketing.


Giving your virtual assistant administrative tasks allows your internal team to focus on their core functions. General virtual assistants can deal with a range of admin and clerical tasks, while more specialized assistants can fill various roles of their own. The types of virtual assistants have grown over the years to meet the growing needs of businesses.

## A Comprehensive Virtual Assistant Task List


Here are the things a virtual assistant can do to support different areas of your business.


### Administrative Tasks


General virtual assistants provide virtual administrative assistant services. They can help you deal with the odds and ends of running a business that you’d otherwise have to squeeze into the gaps of your schedule.


- **Calendar Management:** A virtual assistant can ensure you stay organized and punctual by setting reminders, coordinating travel plans, and scheduling meetings.


- [Email Management](https://getmagic.com/blog/email-management-services/) **:** You don’t have to spend time going through every message when you have a virtual assistant to filter out junk email, flag urgent items, and draft effective outreach and response templates.


- **Travel Planning:** From booking flights and accommodations to creating itineraries, a virtual assistant can handle all aspects of travel arrangements.


- **Document Organization and Management:** A virtual assistant can keep your files organized for you, making it easy for anyone on your team to find what they need. This includes managing versions and backups.


- **Transcribing and Formatting Files:** They can transcribe audio or video files into text, which can be used for future reference. This allows better information sharing among your team.


### Research and Data Tasks


Understanding your market and maintaining clean records are critical to growth. Delegating these functions lets you make data-driven decisions at a given time.


- **Data Entry** : Whether it’s inputting information into spreadsheets or databases,


[data entry outsourcing](https://getmagic.com/blog/data-entry-outsourcing/) ensures accuracy and efficiency on data entry tasks. These duties and responsibilities include verifying or scrubbing records, retrieving specific data, and exporting databases.


- **Market Research** : Virtual assistants can conduct thorough market research for your business. This provides valuable insights into industry trends, competitor strategies, and potential opportunities.


- **Competitor Analysis** : Have your virtual assistant analyze your competitors’ strengths, weaknesses, and strategies.


- **Data Mining** : A virtual assistant can extract valuable information from various sources, providing the data you need for informed decision-making.


- **Monitoring Trends and Technologies** : Let your virtual research assistant conduct competitive research, check online reviews, and track your findings.


### Sales Tasks


Building a reliable sales pipeline requires consistent high-volume outreach and meticulous lead qualification. Offloading your prospecting and data management duties keeps that pipeline full and allows your internal team to focus their energy entirely on closing deals.


- **CRM Data Clean-up** : Cleaning up CRM data to purge inaccurate or incomplete entries can vastly improve your sales targeting. They remove duplicate records and enter updated data into the CRM software.


- **Cold Calling** : A virtual assistant can identify, qualify, and reach out to leads and help establish valuable contacts.


- **Nurturing Client Relationships** : Your virtual assistant can do regular customer care calls to follow up on their purchase. This adds value to your product or service and builds a long-lasting relationship.


### Social Media Tasks


Regular activity is crucial to maintaining an online presence, whether through social media or a blog. However, executing a successful social media strategy takes considerable effort. With a general virtual assistant, you can connect and communicate with potential customers without having to divide your attention between other areas of your business.


- **Social Media and Blog Posting** : Virtual assistants can curate third-party content, schedule posts, and manage interactions on your business pages. For blogs, they assist with proofreading and managing a posting schedule.


- **Professional Networking** : A virtual assistant can help you update contact info, schedule meetings, and send follow-up emails. They can research potential connections and industry events, helping you identify valuable opportunities.


### Customer Support Tasks


Keeping customers satisfied requires immediate and reliable attention. A virtual assistant ensures your clients receive prompt, helpful service across your digital channels.


- **Live Chat Management** : For businesses with an online presence, a virtual assistant can manage live chat interactions with customers.


- **Order Processing** : For eCommerce businesses, a virtual assistant can manage order processing, ensuring a seamless customer experience from purchase to delivery.


- **Ticket Handling** : Virtual assistants can efficiently handle your support ticket system. They prioritize tickets or assign them to the right representative.


### Bookkeeping Tasks


Proper financial management is an essential part of operations, even if hiring a full-time accountant falls outside your current budget. A virtual bookkeeping assistant provides reliable support to keep your ledgers organized and ensure your bills are paid on time.


- **Basic Bookkeeping** : A bookkeeping assistant’s major responsibilities include creating general ledgers and reconciling business accounts. They can also assist with reminding you to pay bills and helping you with taxes.


### Technical and Team Tasks


Keeping digital workflows and remote teams running smoothly requires dedicated oversight. That is because they can turn into cluttered bottlenecks if not actively managed. A virtual assistant acts as the operational manager for your digital systems, maintaining your software workflows and keeping remote team communication properly aligned.


- **Automating Business Processes** : Have your virtual assistant set up or adjust automated processes to improve your team’s efficiency. These processes can include sending emails, updating info, or showing pop-ups.


- **Coordinating Virtual Teams** : A virtual assistant can handle the upkeep of coworking platforms or kanbans, monitoring progress and reminding people of deadlines.


## Essential Virtual Assistant Skills To Look For


If you are evaluating tasks to outsource to a virtual assistant, you must match the task to the right talent. Look for these specific skill sets and attributes:


- **Communication Skills:** Clear and effective communication is paramount for a virtual assistant to understand your requirements and provide accurate deliverables.


- **Organization and Time Management:** The ability to manage tasks efficiently, prioritize work, and meet deadlines is crucial for a virtual assistant’s effectiveness.


- **Technological Proficiency:** A virtual assistant should be adept at using digital tools and platforms relevant to your business operations.


- **Adaptability:** A virtual assistant should be adaptable to new technologies, processes, and tasks.


- **Specialized Skills:** Depending on your specific requirements, consider hiring a virtual assistant with specialized skills such as executive assistant experience, graphic design proficiency, or social media management expertise.


## Real-World Virtual Assistant Examples


To better understand how these responsibilities translate to actual business relief, you need to see these roles in action. Here are a few real-world virtual assistant examples of how you can deploy different types of remote talent to solve specific operational bottlenecks.


### The Executive Partner


Administrative overload usually strikes at the worst possible moments. Imagine stepping off a cross-country flight only to discover that afternoon meetings now overlap with a newly scheduled investor call. Fifty urgent emails have just flooded your inbox, creating immediate panic before the terminal Wi-Fi even connects.


A remote executive assistant can eliminate this chaos. They’ll monitor your schedule in real time and adjust your calendar for the flight delay. They can categorize your inbox so you only see the three emails that require your urgent attention. They’ve also texted your hotel check-in details and arranged your transportation. You walk out of the airport entirely prepared for your next objective.


### The Sales Engine


Closing deals requires momentum, but that momentum dies when top representatives spend half their week manually scrubbing outdated contact information. The sales pipeline stalls out entirely. Instead of actually speaking to prospects, the team gets bogged down with endless database entry.


A virtual assistant steps in to handle the tedious data management. They can execute a thorough CRM data clean-up, removing duplicate contacts and formatting phone numbers. They then build a fresh prospect list based on the parameters you provided and qualify initial leads. This sets up the framework for your sales team to start cold calling immediately.


### The Customer Champion


Launching a major product update inevitably triggers a massive traffic spike. Suddenly, a wave of basic shipping inquiries and password reset requests floods the system. Highly paid engineers get distracted by these low-level support tickets, which delay crucial bug fixes and frustrate the entire team.


A customer support assistant acts as your first line of defense. They monitor your website’s live chat to answer basic inquiries instantly. They process new orders and handle routine ticket resolution. When a complex technical issue arises, they properly prioritize the ticket and assign it to your engineering team. Your customers receive rapid responses, and your technical team remains focused.


### The Marketing Catalyst


An active online presence drives growth, yet maintaining it takes hours that busy leaders simply do not have. As a result, the company blog sits dormant for months, and social media pages show zero recent activity. Daily operations completely eclipse the time needed to write updates or source engaging images.


A general virtual assistant takes ownership of this digital routine. They curate relevant third-party content and manage interactions on your business pages. They assist with proofreading blog posts, sourcing images, and managing a consistent posting schedule. Your brand stays visible and connected to your target audience without dividing your focus.


## The Core Benefits of Hiring a Virtual Assistant


The decision to outsource administrative tasks goes beyond simply checking items off a daily to-do list. Choosing to leverage

When you transition from doing it all yourself to delegating strategically, you fundamentally change how your operations scale, offering

- **Cost-Efficiency:** Hiring a virtual assistant removes the need for physical office space, equipment, and associated overheads. It’s easier and more cost-efficient than hiring full-time professionals who require a fixed salary and benefits, as well as office equipment and training. This means you only pay for the productive time you actually need.


- **Increased Productivity:** It’s a common misconception that remote workers lack productivity due to unsupervised working environments. However, Future Forum reports a

There are fewer distractions at home, so work can be done quickly and effectively. This gives you and your team more time to focus on core business functions.


- **Scalability:** The unparalleled flexibility of flexible hires allow you to scale up or down as needed to cater to fluctuating workloads. Get on-demand assistance to solve staffing issues quickly.


- **Global Access to Talent:** With virtual assistant outsourcing, you can access a global pool of remote workers to find the right expertise for your needs. Access to global talent can also provide a unique perspective in getting work done.


## Should You Hire a Virtual Assistant On Your Own?: Evaluating Your Hiring Strategy


When you are ready to stop doing everything yourself, you have to decide how to source your support. You can approach this independently, or you can partner with an established firm.


### Hiring a Virtual Assistant Independently


The do-it-yourself route naturally appeals to business owners who want absolute oversight. Platforms like Upwork and Freelancer are excellent places to find virtual assistants directly. Choosing this path means you:


- Maintain total control over the candidate selection process


- Define the exact parameters for the role


- Negotiate rates by yourself


- Gain the freedom to handpick the specific individual that best aligns with your working style


That level of control, however, comes with a steep operational cost. You will need to source, screen, and conduct interviews or trial projects on your own if you go for freelancing platforms. This reality turns a delegation strategy into a heavy administrative burden.


The process requires a massive upfront investment of your personal time to vet portfolios and verify references. Instead of clearing your schedule, you end up adding hours of human resources administration to your workload.


Lastly, independent hires do not come with a safety net. If your new assistant quits or fails to meet expectations, you are forced to restart the entire exhaustive search process from scratch.


### Partnering With a Staffing Firm


Handing the hiring process over to a third party can feel uncomfortable at first. Relying on an agency means trusting an external team to fully understand the unique administrative demands of your daily operations. You might feel like you’re giving up the ability to browse thousands of profiles and directly negotiate every detail of the contract.


That initial loss of control translates directly into massive time savings. Outsourcing companies can streamline and even expedite how you find a virtual assistant that’s right for you. They already have a pool of virtual assistants they can screen to match the skills and requirements you need in a job. Agencies handle the heavy lifting of recruitment to ensure quality.


At Magic, applicants come through open calls, employee referrals, and job-hunting sites. From that broad list, only about 5% of the candidates make it to our talent pool for remote staffing matching.


Getting the help of an outsourcing agency means you also benefit from built-in infrastructure. They offer VA replacements, 24/7 support, performance management, data security, and other unique services. If you think the candidate isn’t a perfect fit, you can simply get your VA replaced without starting from scratch.
